metadata.title: Rectangular Cyclotomic Expansions of Colored HOMFLY-PT Polynomials
metadata.abstract: We prove the rectangular cyclotomic expansion conjecture of Kameyama, Nawata, Tao, and Zhang for reduced colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials of arbitrary zero-framed knots. We also prove their explicit double-twist formula for every rectangular color and all pairs of nonzero integer twist parameters. For each knot, we construct a double Newton expansion with coefficients in $\mathbb Z[A^{\pm1},q^{\pm1}]$. These coefficients are uniquely determined and independent of the width and height of the rectangular color. The construction uses finite-rank representation symmetries and integral interpolation. The double-twist formula follows from a simultaneous exterior-power comparison of the two four-point Casimir operators and the known one-row formula. Finite transition formulas express the double Newton coefficients of double-twist knots in terms of the prescribed twist coefficients.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 矩形色 HOMFLY-PT 的 cyclotomic 展开
analysis.workSummary: 对任意零 framing 结，证明固定矩形高度的宽度 Newton 展开系数属于整数 Laurent 环，带确定奇偶性与整除因子；再次按高度插值获得独立于宽、高的唯一双参数系数族，交换宽高对应 q↦q⁻¹。把一行分区设为 Newton 系数、其余分区系数置零，给出所引用矩形 cyclotomic 展开猜想的一种解；双扭结则另有含 Schur 特化及盒乘积核的显式有限公式。
techniques: 矩形色 HOMFLY–PT 不变量
analysis.breakthrough: 将矩形色展开猜想与双扭公式纳入统一整系数构造。
analysis.limitations: Newton 系数的唯一性不能直接推广为所有分区索引展开系数唯一。一般结的整数展开与双扭结族的显式公式是两个层次的结论，约化和 framing 约定须保持一致。
